domain.name: Containers & Development Environments
domain.description: Docker/container concepts, images, volumes, networks, Compose, build caching, local dev environments, debugging, and reproducibility.

competencies.name: Containers, Images & Runtime Model
competencies.description: Understand images, containers, layers, registries, processes, and isolation.
competencies.purpose: Reason about container behavior instead of treating Docker commands as magic.

units.title: Image is template, container is runtime instance
units.content: Images are immutable layer sets used to create containers; container writable state is ephemeral unless intentionally persisted.

units.title: Container reasoning workflow
units.content: Identify image, tag or digest; inspect command and entrypoint; inspect environment and mounts; inspect network and ports; inspect logs and exit code; reproduce with minimal run arguments.

units.title: Container model failures
units.content: Avoid storing important state only in container writable layers, assuming a tag is immutable, and rebuilding before inspecting the actual failed container.

drills.title: Explain disappearing container data
drills.prompt: Diagnose why application data vanished after recreating a container.

competencies.name: Dockerfiles & Reproducible Builds
competencies.description: Create efficient, cacheable, and understandable container builds.

units.title: Dockerfile workflow
units.content: Choose appropriate base image; copy dependency manifests before source when cache-friendly; pin important runtime versions; install dependencies; copy app; set non-root user where practical; define start behavior; keep secrets out of image layers.

units.title: Layer order controls cache efficiency
units.content: Stable, expensive dependency steps should come before frequently changing source when build semantics allow.

units.title: Build failures
units.content: Avoid latest-only dependencies without intent, copying secrets into the image, giant build contexts, package caches left unnecessarily, and opaque build steps that cannot be debugged.

drills.title: Review a slow Dockerfile
drills.prompt: Improve build caching, image size, security, and debuggability.

competencies.name: Volumes, Bind Mounts & Persistent Data
competencies.description: Choose correct storage for databases, source code, caches, and generated files.
competencies.purpose: Preserve important state while keeping development flexible.

units.title: Mount type should match ownership of data
units.content: Bind mounts expose host paths; named volumes are runtime-managed persistent storage; container layers are temporary.

units.title: Storage design
units.content: Classify data as source, config, cache, durable app state, or output; choose bind mount, volume, or temporary storage accordingly; set permissions; back up durable volumes; test recreate behavior.

units.title: Storage failures
units.content: Avoid mounting over required image files accidentally, keeping databases in ephemeral layers, and using host-specific absolute paths that destroy portability.

drills.title: Design storage for a local stack
drills.prompt: Choose mounts for source code, database data, uploads, logs, and caches.

competencies.name: Container Networking & Ports
competencies.description: Understand service discovery, bridges, localhost boundaries, published ports, and inter-container communication.

units.title: localhost is namespace-relative
units.content: Inside a container, localhost refers to that container; services on the host or another container need the correct network path or service name.

units.title: Network diagnosis
units.content: Identify caller and target namespaces; inspect listening address and port; inspect network membership and service name; test DNS; test container-to-container path; only then inspect host firewall or published ports.

units.title: Network failures
units.content: Avoid changing host firewall before proving the issue leaves the container network, hardcoding container IPs, and publishing every internal service to the host.

drills.title: Debug API-to-database connectivity
drills.prompt: A web container cannot reach a database container though both start. Build the diagnosis.

competencies.name: Compose & Multi-Service Local Stacks
competencies.description: Define repeatable multi-service development environments with dependencies and configuration.

units.title: Compose workflow
units.content: Define services, images or builds, ports, networks, volumes, healthchecks, and environment inputs; avoid relying on startup order alone; use health or readiness logic; keep secrets outside committed Compose files.

units.title: Started is not ready
units.content: A database process can be running before it accepts connections; readiness matters more than container start order.

units.title: Compose failures
units.content: Avoid treating dependency order as readiness, duplicate conflicting port mappings, embedding secrets, and one shared volume for unrelated service state.

drills.title: Design a local AI app stack
drills.prompt: Plan Compose for API, UI, Redis, database, and optional search service.

competencies.name: Logs, Shells & Container Debugging
competencies.description: Use logs, inspect, exec, resource stats, health, and exit codes to diagnose failures.
competencies.purpose: Fix the right layer instead of rebuilding blindly.

units.title: Container debug loop
units.content: Read logs and exit code; inspect configuration, mounts, and environment; confirm process command; enter a shell only when image allows; test dependencies from inside the namespace; reproduce with minimal changes.

units.title: Debugging failures
units.content: Avoid repeatedly deleting containers before capturing evidence, editing running containers as the permanent fix, and assuming build success means runtime dependencies work.

units.title: Runtime failure can be configuration, not image code
units.content: Check mounts, secrets, environment, DNS, and external dependencies before rewriting the Dockerfile.

drills.title: Diagnose a crash-looping container
drills.prompt: Create a minimal evidence and isolation plan.
rubric: Permanent fix not edited in running container

competencies.name: Dev Containers & Environment Reproducibility
competencies.description: Package project toolchains and editor/runtime dependencies into portable development environments.

units.title: Dev environment design
units.content: List required runtime, compiler, and tool versions; separate project dependencies from personal editor preference; define container image or setup; mount source safely; expose needed ports; document GPU or device needs; test on a clean host.

units.title: Environment failures
units.content: Avoid baking credentials into dev images, making the container depend on hidden host paths, and assuming GPU or device access works without explicit configuration.

units.title: Reproducible does not mean identical personal UI
units.content: Standardize the project toolchain and commands; leave harmless editor preferences local.

drills.title: Design a reproducible AI dev environment
drills.prompt: Plan a containerized development setup with Node, Python, CUDA-sensitive components, and VS Code.

competencies.name: Image Maintenance & Supply-Chain Hygiene
competencies.description: Update bases and dependencies while preserving reproducibility and reviewing risk.
competencies.purpose: Keep container stacks maintainable without uncontrolled drift.

units.title: Image maintenance workflow
units.content: Track base image and dependency versions; review changelogs and security advisories; rebuild from clean cache when needed; scan where available; test application behavior; pin critical bases; roll forward deliberately.

units.title: Maintenance failures
units.content: Avoid blindly updating every image to latest, ignoring end-of-life bases, running unnecessary privileged containers, and treating a scanner score as context-free proof of exploitability.

units.title: Patch with evidence and rollback
units.content: Security updates matter, but changes still need compatibility testing and a known rollback path.

drills.title: Plan a base-image upgrade
drills.prompt: Create a safe upgrade process for a production-like local service image.
